blurb: Guests can visit the log cabin tasting room, stroll through the vineyard, and enjoy a glass of wine on the porch. The site features a notable maple tree that inspired their logo and offers relaxing seating areas. They host a music series with live bands where guests can bring picnics and enjoy CHV wines and slushies.
